This is an R Markdown document serving as the directory. You can find links to the slides and more information of the course *Introduction to Linguistic Theories* (Fall, 2026). May you enjoy taking the course.
<br><br>
<u>latest date for submitting a late assignment</u>: <b>11:59 pm, Dec 13, 2026</b>
<br><br>

### [Syllabus](syllabus.pdf) (clickable)<br><br>

<script>
function showScheduleModule(event, moduleName) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.schedule-tab').forEach(function(tab) {
    tab.classList.remove('active');
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.schedule-panel').forEach(function(panel) {
    panel.classList.remove('active');
  });

  if (event && event.currentTarget) {
    event.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
  }

  var panel = document.getElementById('schedule-' + moduleName);
  if (panel) {
    panel.classList.add('active');
  }
}
</script>
